facts.text: New first-year and transfer students residing in Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Virginia, West Virginia, or Washington, D.C. are eligible for the Discover Penn State Award.

sources.title: Discover Award | Penn State Hazleton
sources.quote: Students must reside in: Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Virginia, and West Virginia, as well as the District of Columbia (other out-of-state residents are not eligible for this award) Recipients must be NEW undergraduate first-year or transfer students
